// diagnostic E2002

Jet.DeprecatedPastWindow

A deprecated item was used past its migration window.

What

A deprecated item was used past its migration window.

Why

The item was deprecated in an earlier edition and no longer exists in this one; it has reached the end of its migration window.

Fix

Use the named replacement, or run `jet fix` to migrate automatically.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.DeprecatedPastWindow: Tests/UI/deprecated_past_window_e2002.stderr.

Error: Jet.DeprecatedPastWindow: `old_fn` was removed in edition 2026
  --> deprecated_past_window_e2002.jet:7:8
    |
  7 |     _: old_fn()
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: `old_fn` was deprecated in edition 2024 and no longer exists in this edition; it has reached the end of its migration window.
 Fix: Use `fresh` instead, or run `jet fix` to migrate automatically.
